Introduction

Kim Jae Joong also known as Jaejoong and as J-Jun in Japan, is a South Korean Singer-songwriter, Actor, Director, and Designer under iNKODE. He is a member of the boy group JYJ, the duo JX, and a former member of TVXQ!. He made his solo debut on January 17, 2013, with the mini album I.

Kim Jae Joong created his own company in May of 2023 called, iNKODE. In July of the same year, he started a weekly YouTube show called Jaefriends, where he interviews various celebrities.
